description: The window navigates to http://127.0.0.1:<port>, which Tauri treats as a REMOTE origin. Remote origins are ACL-gated even when the app declares no manifest, so without this capability the dashboard's open_oauth invoke is rejected and OAuth sign-in cannot start, and its set_ui_zoom invoke is rejected so the zoom hotkeys silently do nothing. Scoped to the app's own commands only -- core:default deliberately stays on the local capability.
